subject: Upgrade macos-12 to macos-13 in workflows (#1318)
reason: The change edits only GitHub Actions workflow files (.github/workflows/daily.yml and deps/hiredis/.github/workflows/build.yml), replacing the macos-12 runner image with macos-13. It is a pure CI configuration change with no modification to Valkey server, replication, persistence, tools, or client code, so no runtime behaviour changed and no fuzzer scenario can reach it.
